lucy_hr: Quick Q from EMEA manager: they want to promote an IC on a work visa (tiered sponsorship) with an equity refresh and comp bump. Any special steps for visa holders and equity timing so we don't block onboarding or payroll?

ryan: two things: 1) sponsorship/immigration team must confirm visa status change doesn't require new paperwork before effective date. 2) equity grants for promos usually go through the next grants cycle unless exec signoff for off-cycle refresh.

priya: adding ops detail 1) for visa-holders we need HRBP + immigration confirmation in the packet. 2) if equity vests or grants change, legal needs to approve grant docs pre-signing. 3) comp increases that affect benefits tiers need benefits team cc'd.

ana_payroll: payroll note: international payroll providers often require a signed employment letter with final title/comp before cutover. If documents come after the provider cutoff, the change may not reflect until next cycle and retro will be processed later. Share the cutover window.

people-ops-bot: FYI: Policy "Promo & Equity for Sponsored Employees" v1.2 requires immigration sign-off + legal approval for any equity change prior to updating Workday. See: https://redwoodintra/confluence/promotions/visa-equity

lucy_hr: manager says candidate needs the title and equity update effective on 2026-05-01 (two business days before cutover). Can we guarantee?

ryan: guarantee only if all approvals + signed grant docs + immigration clearance are in People Ops by 48h before cutover. Otherwise payroll will hold and we process next window.

priya: operational checklist I use for these: ```
- Candidate name / employee ID
- Current visa type + immigration contact confirmation
- Manager justification & role profile
- Compensation change (amount, pct) + benefits tier impact
- Equity request: grant type, units, proposed vesting, legal approval link
- HRBP ack
- Immigration sign-off
- Legal sign-off for equity
- Payroll intake timestamp (to meet cutover)
- Final People Ops intake
```

ana_payroll: also add a field: "local payroll provider contact" and whether local currency conversion applies. For ex, some providers require GBP vs USD reporting causing timing diffs.

lucy_hr: good call. Manager also asked about retroactive equity grants if they miss the cycle. Is that doable?

ryan: off-cycle grants are possible but need exec approval and legal sign-off; they may be processed with a grant date that matches effective date but administrative setup can delay actual ledgering. Communicate expectations.

people-ops-bot: Action item created: /task create "Document international promo checklist + sample email for immigration/legal" assigned to priya, due 2026-04-12.

priya: I'll draft the checklist and a short template email for managers to copy to immigration/legal/payroll. Should we include a field for "tax briefing required"?

ana_payroll: yes please. Intl tax can change withholding. Add "tax briefing required yes/no" and which tax advisor.

lucy_hr: final ask 1) can someone write a 2-sentence manager-facing blurb I can drop into the hiring thread? Keep it short and prescriptive.

ryan: draft: "For promotions involving visa-sponsored employees with equity: submit the full packet (immigration + legal + HRBP approvals and signed grant docs) at least 48 hours before the payroll cutover. If any approval is missing at cutover, payroll will hold the change and process in the next cycle; retro pay or off-cycle grants require exec approval and may be delayed."

lucy_hr: perfect. I'll send it. tagging @people-ops-bot to attach the intl-cutover schedule.

people-ops-bot: Attached: https://redwoodintra/drive/payroll/international-cutovers-2026.xlsx. Closing thread after priya posts the checklist.
